sources.title: Surya Scholars Grant — Official Notice
sources.text:
# Surya Scholars Grant — Official Notice

Published: 10 June 2026
Academic cycle: 2026-27

Applicants must have annual household income below Rs 8 lakh.

The online application deadline is 15 December 2026.

Submit an income certificate issued by the Tehsildar with your application.

Apply through the State Student Support Portal.

There is no application fee.

For help, contact the scholarship cell by email.

sources.title: How to apply for the Surya Scholars Grant
sources.text:
# How to apply for the Surya Scholars Grant

Published: 18 July 2026
Academic cycle: 2026-27

Applicants should attach a copy of their latest income-tax return with the application.

The application deadline for the 2026-27 cycle is 15 December 2026.

# Surya Scholars Grant — Archived Notice

Published: 02 May 2023
Academic cycle: 2023-24

For the 2023-24 academic cycle, applicants needed annual household income below Rs 6 lakh.

The application deadline for that cycle was 10 November 2023.

sources.title: Surya Scholars Grant summary
sources.text:
# Surya Scholars Grant summary

Listings describe eligibility as household income below Rs 8 lakh and an award of up to Rs 50,000.

The award is renewable for eligible students.

This summary has no publication date or academic cycle.

warnings: Surya Scholars Grant — Archived Notice was published more than 12 months before this analysis.
Surya Scholars Grant — Archived Notice is from an older academic cycle.

The Rs 6 lakh limit is explicitly for 2023-24; the current official notice is for 2026-27.
The November 2023 date belongs to the archived 2023-24 cycle, not the current 2026-27 cycle.
